name: Unconscious
summary: Incapacitated and Prone, Speed 0, fails Str and Dex saves; hits from within 5 ft are Critical Hits.
text: You have the Incapacitated and Prone conditions and drop whatever you are holding; when this ends you are still Prone. Your Speed is 0 and can't increase. Attack rolls against you have Advantage, you automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws, any attack that hits you from within 5 feet is a Critical Hit, and you are unaware of your surroundings.
